# Core

The [core pipeline](./README.md "references") starts from the README.

## Overview

The [core pipeline overview](./README.md "references") owns enrichment end to
end.

## Pipeline

The [core pipeline stages](./README.md "references") run in order.

### Pipeline stages

Each stage hands its output to the [next core pipeline step](./README.md "references").

## Notes

Keep the [core pipeline](./README.md "references") deduplicated; a noisy
pipeline is the whole problem.
